# V-Island engine source

Source: [BAP-CAMP/v-island](https://github.com/BAP-CAMP/v-island), commit `ba73c70c3b591b2aca874da40a68cfdd0dfc7ab4`, `src/engine/`.

The upstream [CREDITS](https://github.com/BAP-CAMP/v-island/blob/ba73c70c3b591b2aca874da40a68cfdd0dfc7ab4/CREDITS.md) identifies the engine as distilled from [tidewater](https://github.com/dgreenheck/tidewater), original commit `4811ba48`, copyright 2026 DRG Software Solutions LLC, MIT. The full original license is retained as `LICENSE-tidewater.txt` and shipped with runtime resources.

This folder contains only the engine. V-Island island data, audio, character models, props and gameplay have not been imported. Forest integration and weather/audio/model generation are original local adaptations outside this folder. No remote publication occurred in this task.

File hashes and byte counts are recorded in `source-manifest.json`. The vendored `.js` files were copied without modification.
